Diagnosis.submission: Root cause: the rate service (srv-rate) is throughput-throttled by an in-process token-bucket request pacer (requestPacer) limited to RATE_BACKEND_QPS_LIMIT=20 QPS with a 256-slot queue. The application workload (~60% search requests, each searching many hotels via gRPC) drives rate demand to ~24-30 requests/sec, so the pacer processes at most 20/sec while the queue stays full (rate_queue_depth 255/256). This causes massive rate_requests_expired_total (~13.8k, requests that exceed the search-side 750ms deadline) and rate_requests_rejected_total (~3.4k, ResourceExhausted queue-full rejections). The rate service CPU is idle (0.007 cores, 0 CFS throttling) and its downstream dependencies (memcached-rate, mongodb-rate) respond in microseconds, confirming it is pacer-limited, not resource-limited. Consequently the search service (srv-search), which calls rate with a 750ms timeout and 3 retries, reports search_rate_timeouts_total ~4159 and search_rate_failures_total ~1851 out of 5941 attempts and logs dependency=rate grpc_code=DeadlineExceeded/ResourceExhausted, so search returns errors and the end-to-end hotel search path fails. Faulty component: rate service (srv-rate) request pacing/rate limit; impacted: search (srv-search) and frontend search path.
